title: Bain sees US$100 billion SaaS market in agentic AI automation
summary: Bain & Company has estimated a US$100 billion market opportunity in the US for SaaS companies leveraging agentic AI, with the market being driven by automation of coordination work in enterprise systems. This is the second report in Bain's five-part series examining the software industry in the AI era.
problem_solved: Quantifies the market opportunity for AI-driven automation of coordination work in enterprise software environments.
why_valuable: Provides concrete market sizing data that can guide strategic investment decisions for SaaS companies and investors in the AI space.
